title: Cling malware family is not Mirai despite antivirus classification
content_md:
Cling, the most-read family on the blog, is now also available in Spanish. Antivirus engines file it under Mirai. It is not Mirai: it does not come to knock servers offline

via Mastodon https://blog.efespain.com/cling/
exclude_reason: Malware-family analysis blog post (Cling). No new incident or advisory.
